translation:
Title: Selection of Examination Administrators for the 16th Bar Examination (2027) (by Friday, 6 November)

The Ministry of Justice is selecting undergraduate students of our university to work as examination administrators (시험관리원) at the 16th Bar Examination in 2027. Interested currently enrolled students are asked to apply.

1. Eligibility: Currently enrolled students in years 1 to 4
   * Fourth-year students who plan to enter a law school (법학전문대학원) or who plan to take up employment are excluded.

2. Number to be selected: 21 (reserve candidates may be selected depending on the Ministry of Justice's circumstances)

3. Place of work: Law Building (Building 15), Seoul National University

4. Work period and duties: See [Attachment 1]

5. Allowance: 100,000 won on weekdays; 120,000 won on holidays

6. How to apply: Send the application form in [Attachment 2] individually by email to the staff member in charge by Friday, 6 November. (The email address is given in the original notice.)

7. Selection: The Ministry of Justice plans to notify selected students by telephone between Tuesday, 24 November 2026 and Friday, 27 November 2026. (Students who cannot be reached will not be selected.)

8. Enquiries: Legal Professionals Division (법조인력과), Ministry of Justice (the telephone number is given in the original notice).

Attachments (2):
Attachment 1. 시험관리원 근무안내.hwp (Examination Administrator Work Guide) (55 KB)
Attachment 2. 시험관리원 근무 지원서(서울대).xlsx (Examination Administrator Application Form (SNU)) (12 KB)

(Note: The contents of the attachments were not read for this translation.)
